channel.title: Pier & Point · 1700 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1700 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: A claim that a Gladstone research center is housed in this building was removed because the only page that supported it no longer exists.
item.description: A claim that a Gladstone research center is housed in this building was removed because the only page that supported it no longer exists. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · 1700 Owens Street: The map notes said the construction date was not confirmed, though the record cites a DBI permit completed 2007-10-02 and an Assessor year built of 2007, so both notes were corrected. The summary no longer says CFAR is based at 1700 Owens, since the cited page only lists CFAR events held there; the Taube-Koret Center for Huntington's Disease Research is now cited to Gladstone's own contact page, which places it in the 1700 building (the page is undated, so current occupancy is flagged unconfirmed).
